traceability.notes: The 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP story is fully implemented. The project provides a TypeScript-based ESLint plugin with a dynamic rule registry, proper default and named exports, and ESLint v9 flat-config presets. Package metadata and build configuration support publishing as an npm package with type declarations. Multiple Jest tests explicitly reference this story and its requirements, validating plugin exports, rule registration, config presets, CLI integration, and robust error handling when rules fail to load. The README and linked user docs give clear installation and configuration instructions for end users. All related tests pass in the full Jest run, so all acceptance criteria and technical requirements for this story are satisfied.
